metadata.title: Spiritual Collective Portrait with Geometric Anchor

retrievalProfile.description: A multi-figure ensemble portrait arranged symmetrically around a central glowing geometric anchor with a high-contrast color header.
triggerTerms: magenta header with serif display type

recipe.visualDefinition: A dense grid of diverse individuals dressed in white, radiating outward from a central glowing pyramid, topped by a solid magenta banner containing wide-spaced serif typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Central glowing pyramid as the primary focal point
Symmetrical arrangement of portraits creating a halo effect
High-contrast magenta header bar against a dark background
Uniformity of white clothing across a diverse group
coreInvariants: The central geometric shape must emit a soft white glow that bleeds into surrounding portraits.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A central figure is positioned directly above the pyramid; other figures are scaled similarly and arranged in a tiered, semi-circular formation.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: A magenta-bordered pyramid with a bright light source at its center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the central glow, move upward to the lead figure, then outward to the surrounding faces, finally resting on the top header.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is packed with faces, with dark space only visible in the upper corners and behind the header.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value in the center (glow) transitioning to deep shadows in the background; high saturation in the magenta header.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for maximum impact and clarity.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the elegant, high-contrast serif feel with wide proportions.
Provides the wide, authoritative uppercase presence.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a dense collage of diverse people in white shirts arranged around a central glowing magenta-bordered pyramid on a dark background, with a solid magenta bar at the very top.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place wide-tracked, uppercase serif text in black centered within the top magenta bar.

verificationChecks: Is the text centered in the magenta bar?
Does the pyramid have a central light source?
Is the tracking wide enough to span the width of the image?

adjustableVariables: Number of people in the ensemble
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original subjects
Any specific logos or brand marks
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the magenta header is a solid, flat color.
Verify the central pyramid is perfectly centered.
Check that the glow does not obscure the faces too much.
Confirm the serif font has high stroke contrast.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a symmetrical multi-subject portrait in uniform attire with a central glowing geometric icon and a high-contrast typographic header.
